items.subject: Spanish couples in their twenties dancing in a grand Madrid ballroom, among them a slim mid-20s Spanish woman with dark set hair and a lean late-20s Spanish man in a dark suit
items.action: the man and the woman meet on the dance floor, his arm offered as a waltz begins
items.gaze_interaction: the pair turned toward each other, her head tilted slightly up to him; surrounding dancers read as backs and moving silhouettes
items.setting: ballroom of the Círculo de Bellas Artes, Madrid, 1961, high coffered ceiling, tall arched windows, polished parquet
items.color_palette: warm gold, ivory plaster, deep burgundy drapes, black suits and pale dresses
items.props_detail: a crystal chandelier blazing above the parquet
items.camera_angle: eye-level from the edge of the dance floor
items.lighting: warm tungsten chandelier light, soft evening glow
items.mood: gentle warmth, couples swaying close, soft light pooling on the floor
items.narration_anchor: Dieciséis de septiembre de mil novecientos sesenta y uno. En el salón de baile del Círculo de Bellas Artes de Madrid, Daniel Écija conoce a María Bernal.

items.subject: newlywed Spanish couple, mid-20s woman in a simple white wedding dress and late-20s man in a dark suit, seen from behind
items.action: the couple step down from a Madrid church doorway after their Thursday wedding, a few relatives tossing rice
items.gaze_interaction: couple facing away toward the street, her arm hooked through his; relatives read by form at the edges
items.setting: stone steps of a modest Madrid parish church, September 1962
items.color_palette: pale granite, white lace, charcoal suits, muted autumn sky
items.props_detail: a small bouquet of white flowers held at her side
items.camera_angle: slightly high angle from inside the doorway
items.mood: quiet modest celebration, rice scattered on worn stone
items.narration_anchor: Un año después se casan: el jueves veinte de septiembre de mil novecientos sesenta y dos.

items.subject: hundreds of Spanish emigrants in 1960s travel clothes lining the decks of a large ocean liner, filling the frame
items.action: the liner pulls away from the quay as passengers crowd the rails waving handkerchiefs
items.gaze_interaction: crowd faces turned toward the shrinking quay, most read as silhouettes against the white superstructure
items.setting: Spanish port quay, 1962, steel liner hull towering over cargo cranes
items.color_palette: white steel, black hull, rust streaks, grey water, sun-faded clothing
items.props_detail: cardboard suitcases tied with string stacked by the gangway
items.mood: crowded rails, fluttering handkerchiefs, widening strip of water
items.narration_anchor: Cuatro días más tarde ya están en el barco. Van a Australia con el acuerdo migratorio por el que pasaron cerca de ocho mil españoles.

items.subject: young Spanish couple, mid-20s woman and late-20s man in plain travel clothes, seen from behind
items.action: they stand together at the ship's rail looking out at open sea
items.gaze_interaction: both turned toward the empty horizon, shoulders touching
items.setting: open promenade deck of a migrant liner at sea, 1962
items.color_palette: deep sea blue, white railings, salt-faded deck planks
items.props_detail: a single shared cardboard suitcase at their feet
items.mood: vast flat horizon, two small figures close together
items.narration_anchor: De Wittenoom no saben nada; saben que hay trabajo y que van juntos.

items.subject: a mid-20s Spanish woman, slender, dark hair pinned back, in a modest cotton dress, beside her late-20s Spanish husband with a lean work-hardened build
items.action: she presses close against his side on the crowded deck, her arm wrapped through his
items.gaze_interaction: her face toward the front, chin lifted, head leaning on his shoulder; he looks out to sea
items.setting: crowded liner deck among other emigrants, 1962
items.color_palette: faded cotton blues, white steel, sea grey
items.props_detail: a small leather handbag clutched against her dress
items.mood: body pressed close, sea wind lifting loose strands of hair
items.narration_anchor: «Iba pegadita a mi marido, como una niña», recuerda su mujer.

items.subject: two Spanish migrant couples in their twenties and thirties, sun-faded clothes dusted red
items.action: they share an evening meal at a small table outside a corrugated iron house, laughing together
items.gaze_interaction: figures leaning toward each other over the table, faces in warm side light
items.setting: veranda of a simple corrugated iron and asbestos cement house in an active desert mining town, 1962
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, weathered grey iron, faint blue-grey dust
items.props_detail: a shared wine bottle and tin plates on an oilcloth
items.mood: warm closeness, long shadows across red dust
items.narration_anchor: Con el tiempo se hicieron amigos íntimos de otra pareja, Milagros Barroso y Ramón de Juan. Esa familia madrileña había hecho el mismo viaje un mes antes.

items.subject: a Spanish boy about eight, thin, in shorts and a short-sleeved shirt, small on a vast deck
items.action: he sits in a narrow strip of shade on the sun-blasted deck
items.gaze_interaction: head tipped back against a bulkhead, shirt dark with sweat
items.setting: open liner deck under a blazing tropical sky, 1962
items.color_palette: bleached white steel, hard blue sky, sweat-darkened cotton
items.props_detail: a cap pushed back on his damp hair
items.mood: glaring heat, heat shimmer above steel deck
items.narration_anchor: Un niño que hizo ese viaje todavía recuerda el calor.

items.subject: a Spanish boy about eight with his parents, a weathered Spanish couple in their thirties carrying bundles
items.action: the boy climbs the steep gangway into the liner, gripping a small suitcase
items.gaze_interaction: boy looking up at the towering hull, parents behind read by form
items.setting: Málaga harbour quay, 1962, liner hull and mooring ropes
items.color_palette: black hull, white superstructure, sandy stone quay, worn brown suitcases
items.mood: tiny figure against a massive steel wall
items.narration_anchor: Víctor Calvo era un niño cuando subió a ese barco.

items.subject: a migrant ocean liner leaving Málaga harbour
items.action: the ship steams out past the breakwater into open sea, wake trailing behind
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction toward the open horizon, the city receding
items.setting: Málaga bay, 1962, whitewashed city and hills behind
items.color_palette: Mediterranean blue, white hull, ochre hills, whitewash
items.props_detail: a long white wake cutting the water
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, wide lens
items.mood: calm sea, small ship in vast water
items.narration_anchor: «Salimos de Málaga y tardamos más de 20 días en llegar en barco a Australia», dice Calvo.

items.subject: a migrant liner gliding through the Suez Canal, Spanish passengers crowding the shaded decks
items.action: passengers fan themselves with newspapers and hats as the ship moves between desert banks
items.gaze_interaction: figures turned toward the passing sand, slumped against railings, shirts soaked with sweat
items.setting: Suez Canal, 1962, flat sand banks close on both sides
items.color_palette: pale sand, bleached sky, white hull, sweat-dark clothes
items.props_detail: a folded newspaper used as a fan
items.camera_angle: high angle from the upper deck
items.mood: heat haze rising, limp bodies in thin shade
items.narration_anchor: Recuerda el canal de Suez y el calor que hacía ahí, un calor que todavía lo hace resoplar cuando lo cuenta.

items.subject: a pale Spanish boy about eight and his mother, a worn Spanish woman in her thirties, among other emigrants on a lower deck
items.action: the boy slumps against a steel bulkhead, seasick, as his mother steadies him
items.gaze_interaction: his head bowed, her face turned toward a porthole, shoulders drawn up
items.setting: cramped lower passenger deck with bunks, 1962
items.color_palette: dull grey steel, sickly green paint, dim brass
items.props_detail: a tin basin on the floor beside the bunk
items.lighting: dim light from a single porthole
items.mood: rolling floor, harsh light from one small window, bodies hunched
items.narration_anchor: Recuerda los mareos. Y la incertidumbre: no saber muy bien adónde iban ni cómo iban a vivir.

items.subject: a small twin-propeller light aircraft of the early 1960s
items.action: the plane bucks through turbulent air above the red desert, wings tilting
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction along the shuddering wing toward endless red ground
items.setting: sky over the Pilbara desert, Western Australia, 1962
items.color_palette: rust red earth, ochre ridges, dusty blue sky, silver aluminium
items.camera_angle: slightly low angle alongside the aircraft
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, motion blur on propellers
items.mood: rough air, tiny plane above an empty red expanse
items.narration_anchor: Después del barco, un avión pequeño, de hélices, que se sacude durante todo el vuelo.

items.subject: the small propeller plane touching down on a remote dirt airstrip
items.action: wheels hit the strip, throwing up a huge billowing cloud of red and blue-grey dust
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction along the airstrip into the dust plume
items.setting: desert airstrip in the Pilbara, Western Australia, 1962, a lone corrugated iron shed
items.color_palette: deep red earth, ochre, blue-grey dust, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a weathered corrugated iron shed beside the strip
items.camera_angle: low angle from the strip edge
items.mood: dust swallowing the plane, flat red horizon

text_in_image.location: on the side of the airstrip shed

items.narration_anchor: Aterriza en una pista en medio de una tierra muy roja, en el desierto de Pilbara, en Australia Occidental. Hay polvo por todas partes.

items.subject: a newly arrived Spanish family, a Spanish boy about eight in front, small among rows of simple houses
items.action: the family is led along a dusty street toward houses of corrugated iron, wood and asbestos cement sheeting
items.gaze_interaction: the boy staring around at dust drifting over the street, clothes already reddened
items.setting: active desert mining town, 1962, low iron-roofed houses on a tailings-surfaced street
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, weathered grey iron, faded paint, hints of blue-grey
items.props_detail: a battered suitcase dragging through the dust
items.mood: dust hanging in the air, small figures in a sun-flattened street
items.narration_anchor: Ese niño cuenta que nunca había visto tanto polvo. Los llevan a las casas: chapa, madera y uralita.

items.subject: crocidolite mine and mill in a red gorge, with miners in dusty workwear
items.action: blue asbestos tailings spill from the mill as ore trucks haul rock from the gorge
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction from the mill down to the growing blue-grey heaps
items.setting: Wittenoom Gorge mine and mill, Pilbara, 1962, red rock walls
items.color_palette: red rock, ochre, steel grey, striking blue-grey tailings
items.props_detail: an ore truck coated in fine dust
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, wide lens
items.mood: mill dust drifting over the gorge, tiny workers among heaps
items.narration_anchor: De esa tierra sacan crocidolita, el asbesto azul, un mineral que se paga bien porque aguanta el calor y no se gasta.

items.subject: a Spanish migrant family outside their corrugated iron home: a mid-20s Spanish woman sweeping, a Spanish boy about eight barefoot on the patio
items.action: the woman sweeps fine blue-grey dust off the patio as it resettles, the boy sitting in it
items.gaze_interaction: woman bent over her broom, the boy looking toward the front, dust on his legs and hair
items.setting: house patio surfaced with asbestos tailings in an active mining town, 1962
items.color_palette: red earth, faded paint, weathered iron, pale blue-grey dust
items.props_detail: a straw broom raising a haze of blue-grey dust
items.lighting: late afternoon low sun backlighting the dust
items.mood: glowing dust hanging in the air around unsuspecting figures
items.narration_anchor: Nadie les dijo qué era el polvo. La compañía lo sabía desde hacía dieciocho años.
